paper_title: Learning to Reason under Off-Policy Guidance
caption: Pass@8 accuracy (on the merge sets of AIME 2024 and AMC) under different generation temperatures.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the accuracy, denoted as “Pass@8,” with respect to temperature, comparing the performance of four different methods: “On-policy RL,” “LUFFY,” and “SFT,” alongside a baseline. The x-axis, labeled “Temperature,” is a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, with tick marks incrementing by 0.1. The y-axis, representing “Pass@8 accuracy,” is also linear and ranges from approximately 62.0 to 80.0, with tick marks spaced approximately every 5 units. The “On-policy RL” line, represented by a red marker and a solid line, begins at approximately 73.0, decreases to around 68.0, then increases to approximately 78.0, and finally declines to around 75.0 by the end of the x-axis. The “LUFFY” line, indicated by an orange marker and a solid line, starts at approximately 68.0, fluctuates between 67.0 and 70.0, and maintains a relatively stable value near 69.0 throughout the x-axis. The “SFT” line, represented by a dark blue marker and a solid line, begins at approximately 73.0, decreases to around 70.0, increases to approximately 76.0, and then declines to approximately 72.0. The baseline line, depicted by a teal marker and a solid line, starts at approximately 62.0, increases to around 68.0, and remains relatively constant near 67.0 across the x-axis.
